run_type: local Python execution, not GitHub Actions

rule.overnight_range: Non-flat M5 bars opening from 00:00 through 09:25 America/New_York inclusive; full 114-slot 5m grid; at least 60 non-flat bars
rule.session_validity: Full 78-slot 09:30–15:55 ET grid, at least 60 non-flat session bars, non-flat 15:55 exit-open bar
rule.signal: First non-flat M5 close outside overnight range between 09:30 and 15:50 ET
rule.direction: close above overnight high = long; close below overnight low = short
rule.entry: next non-flat M5 open after signal candle completion and before 15:55 ET
rule.stop: signal bar low for long, signal bar high for short
rule.exit: M5 BID OHLC; stop first; gap-through-stop at open; remaining trade exits at 15:55 bar open before using the final candle's high/low
rule.cost: modeled round-trip price cost at 1bp and 2bp of entry price; not verified execution cost

selection.basis: discovery-only; >=50 closed trades and PF@2bp >=1.00; highest discovery count then PF@2bp

limitations: BID-only source; no ASK quote series
live spread, broker/prop commission, financing and slippage not verified
